relationships.subject: NaV1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: These results demonstrate that NaV1.7 channels contribute to NG excitability.

relationships.subject: compound 194
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings demonstrate that restoration of the endocytic machinery with Numb recapitulates 194′s inhibition of NaV1.7, implicating CRMP2 deSUMOylation in control of NaV1.7, in a clathrin-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: CRMP2
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed PLA puncta in DRG and NG using antibodies against SUMO1 and CRMP2 (Fig. 5A) and between NaV1.7 and CRMP2 (Fig. 5B).

relationships.subject: Numb
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of Numb rescued CRMP2-dependent regulation on NaV1.7, rendering NG neurons sensitive to 194.

key_findings: NaV1.7 carries most TTX-sensitive current in rat nodose neurons, but CRMP2 knockdown or compound 194 did not reduce it, unlike in DRG.
Numb is lower in nodose ganglia, and Numb overexpression restored 194-mediated NaV1.7 inhibition.
